name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Research doctorate in biological sciences; applicants identify and contact potential faculty mentors.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall admission and assistantship priority
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; confirm the intended admission cycle.

applicationFee.note: International fee $95; domestic $60. No current graduate waiver policy established; old FAQ link unavailable.

english.toefl: 80 legacy; 4.0 current scale, no band below 3.5
english.note: IELTS Academic no band below 6; DET no band below 100. PTE 65/no band below 59 also accepted. Post-secondary English-medium degree exempts testing with proof of instruction language; listed countries exempt. Scores under two years old at application. Unofficial scores accepted for review, official after admission.

documents: Official transcripts from all institutions attended
Written statement: research interests, degree goals, UNLV motivation, potential mentors, explanation of nontraditional grades
CV/resume including education, research/work, publications, presentations, awards and service
Three letters from people familiar with academic record and research potential
requirements.note: Bachelor’s in biological sciences or equivalent; undergraduate GPA 3.0 minimum. Contact one or more potential mentors about joining their labs; no rotation model established. GRE not required in opened 2023 central test table; confirm current departmental policy. Fall admission normally once annually, spring exceptional.

funding.note: Completed December 1 applications receive state-funded assistantship priority; no unconditional funding or stipend established.

timeline.decisions: Fall decisions by April 1 or sooner, according to department.
